title: Add Enterprise Security overview page (public) + SOC 2 request link stubs
author: Elliot Price
description: Context: Enterprise deals are increasingly gated on security/compliance review. We need a public, linkable Enterprise Security overview page that mirrors approved internal FAQ wording without leaking restricted evidence or promising roadmap items. This PR adds a new docs page with deployment-mode-specific notes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), clarifies our customer data handling language, and includes stubs for requesting gated artifacts (e.g., SOC 2 Type II report) via the evidence request process. Scope/Non-goals: This is documentation-only and should not imply new product functionality; any features described must already exist. The page intentionally avoids: (a) claiming ISO 27001 certification, (b) stating absolute data residency guarantees without mode/region caveats, (c) offering pen-test reports publicly, and (d) describing future roadmap for audit logging/SCIM beyond current behavior. What’s included: (1) /enterprise/security overview page with sections: security program overview, data protection, encryption, access controls, audit logging, vulnerability management, incident response, shared responsibility, and deployment mode notes; (2) canonical phrasing for “no training on customer data” consistent with current FAQ; (3) “Request SOC 2 report” link stub that routes to gated evidence request instructions; (4) small nav + metadata updates so Sales/SE can share a stable URL during RFPs.
